components.name: line-chart
components.src: src/components/widgets/LeadsStatsGraphWidget.js scales — y gridlines rgba(0,0,0,0.1) borderDash [3,3] , zero line #e5e9f2 1px; y ticks fontSize 13, fontColor #182b49, beginAtZero, min 0 ; x gridlines transparent, x zero line #e5e9f2 width 2, tickMarkLength 0 , tick padding 10. Series: borderWidth 2, fill false, pointBorderColor '#fff' .

notes.text: TBC — three things. (1) The series values are traced from the screenshot , not sourced; treat every point as ±40. (2) The source sets pointRadius: '0' — a string — yet the live chart clearly shows round markers, so something downstream overrides it; the 2.6px radius here is measured, not declared. (3) The chart is a Chart.js canvas at height=64 with maintainAspectRatio: true , so its painted height is a ratio of its width, not a CSS value. This SVG is a stand-in at the right proportions.
